record.name: VIRAL - One whisper, a living town
record.summary: AI-driven town simulation: whisper a sentence to a resident and watch its consequences. Gemma on AMD generates character reactions; a deterministic engine validates actions and records causal events.
record.contribution: Roy handled AI Agent testing and iteration; his teammate handled competition materials, interface and visual design. They jointly developed the concept and gameplay.
results: Published a playable experience with validated model actions and an inspectable chain of causes.

Includes bounded, cancellable streamed model requests and offline regression tests for resident knowledge boundaries, causal summaries, conversation continuity and invalid responses. Test execution was not independently verified.
limitations: Live runs depend on model latency. Entertainment claims have not been validated with human playtesters.
Roy confirms completion and submission to AMD Developer Hackathon ACT III; results are pending. Division of work is explicitly owner-attested; competition results remain unknown.
lessons: Separate model-generated decisions from deterministic state changes and make failures observable.

discovery.reason: For the AI Engineer / Full-stack Engineer audience, add concrete evidence of model-request controls and regression coverage that the current results omit. Preserve attribution, submission status and existing limitations.
